integrity: The symbolic proof establishes the pointwise vanishing criterion and rank; exploratory Fourier computations are supplementary. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite commutative chain rings of length exactly two and odd residue characteristic; no claims for even characteristic, longer rings, or complete coefficient magnitudes. Residual risk of equivalent earlier local-ring Fourier classification. Numeric FFT tests are not proofs.
title: Complete Fourier support of the determinant graph over length-two odd chain rings
